samples.question: Three colored error bars are shown: one red, one blue, one green. Each error bar has three short horizontal ticks at three distinct heights: a low tick and a high tick (the two outermost ticks) and one middle tick between them. The middle tick of a bar may sit off the vertical midpoint between that bar's own low and high ticks. Which colored bar's middle tick is FARTHEST from the vertical midpoint between its low and high ticks (the most asymmetric error bar)? Answer with only the color: red, blue, or green. (selection by largest center offset).
